UserRhythmState.title: UserRhythmState
UserRhythmState.description: Personal daily rhythm, hydration, commitment streaks, quiet mode, OnePlus 12R hardware preferences, and persistent Living Life Profile (priorities, biometrics, fasting days, night-only circadian sleep, DevOps/work schedule, and global location) synced in real time across phone and desktop.

hydrationDateKey.description: Local date key (YYYY-MM-DD) for today's hydration count.

targetCups.description: Daily hydration target in cups (1 to 30), dynamically calculated from weight, fixed height, cup ml, and fasting status.

hydrationWeeklyCounts.description: 7-day hydration cup counts aligned to the weekly chart.

dailyCommitmentDays.description: Consecutive days of daily commitment streak.

dailyCommitmentDoneToday.description: Whether today's daily commitment is completed.

waterTargetDays.description: Consecutive days hitting the water target.

waterTargetDoneToday.description: Whether today's water target was reached.

quietMode.description: Active synced quiet mode across OnePlus 12R and Windows PC.

adhanOverrideSilent.description: Whether obligatory prayer calls override silent/vibrate mode.

lifeProfile.description: Persistent user constitution with fully flexible Gemini-editable constants: weightKg (30-250), heightCm (100-240), cupSizeMl (50-2000), fastingDays, suhoorLeadMinutes (10-180), sleepTargetMinutes (180-720), sleepStrategy (night_only_strict default), sleepDebtMinutes (0-480), sleepDebtLogDateKey, adhanLeadMinutes (0-30), prayerSilenceMinutes (5-90), fajrSilenceMinutes (5-90), oneTimeSilenceMinutes (0-120), oneTimeSilenceDateKey, lowEnergyDateKey, soundRepeats (per-category 1..4 or continuous), careerTrack, workEnabled/workStart24/workEnd24/workDays, autoLocationSync & timezone/coords, priorityOrderAr, and personalNotes.

syncSignal.description: Optional real-time cross-device workspace sync marker (opId, clientId, scope, action, timestampMs) for sub-second PC <-> Mobile Google Calendar/Tasks reconciliation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set once on creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on every write.

MedicationRecord.title: MedicationRecord
MedicationRecord.description: A daily supplement or medication item (e.g., Pumpkin Seed Oil or any medication added via Gemini) synced with Google Calendar and daily completion tracking.

id.description: Stable identifier for the medication item.

name.description: Display name of the medication or supplement.

time24.description: Optional primary daily time in HH:MM.

times24.description: Optional list of up to 6 daily dose times in HH:MM (supports 1x, 2x, 3x/day or empty if awaiting timing).

daysOfWeek.description: Optional list of active weekdays (0=Sun..6=Sat). Empty array means every day.

takenDosesToday.description: Optional list of up to 6 dose keys logged on takenDateKey.

takenDateKey.description: Local date key (YYYY-MM-DD) when last taken.

calendarEventId.description: Optional linked Google Calendar event ID.

courseEndDate.description: Optional end date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a timed medication/supplement course.

remainingDoses.description: Optional remaining doses counter (-1 untracked, 0 to 500 tracked).

totalDoses.description: Optional initial total doses in package/course (-1 untracked, 0 to 500 tracked).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set once on creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on every write.

CreativeActivityRecord.title: CreativeActivityRecord
CreativeActivityRecord.description: A personal hobby or side project (e.g., reading, side coding, writing) tracked with a weekly session goal, auto-placed into genuinely free daily slots, and synced to Google Calendar.

id.description: Stable identifier for the creative activity.

name.description: Display name of the creative activity or hobby.

emoji.description: Visual emoji representing the creative activity.

weeklyGoalSessions.description: Target number of sessions per week (1 to 14).

cadence.description: Optional tracking period cadence (daily, weekly, or monthly).

goalCount.description: Optional target sessions per cadence period (1 to 31).

sessionMinutes.description: Target duration per session in minutes (15 to 240).

loggedDates.description: Up to 31 recent YYYY-MM-DD local date keys when sessions were completed.

scheduledTime24.description: Optional preferred or calendar-scheduled HH:MM slot.

calendarEventId.description: Optional linked Google Calendar event ID.

expiresOnDate.description: Optional expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) for temporary hobbies/projects.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set once on creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on every write.

MemoryRecord.title: MemoryRecord
MemoryRecord.description: Persistent long-term memory rule or preference taught by the user to Gemini and the self-adapting rhythm engine, synced across devices.

id.description: Stable identifier for the memory entry.

category.description: Topic category for organizing permanent rules.

ruleText.description: The user's explicit rule, decision principle, or preference remembered permanently by Gemini.

source.description: Origin of the saved memory rule.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set once on creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on every write.

/users/{userId}.description: Private per-user real-time synced rhythm, hydration, streaks, OnePlus 12R hardware preferences, and persistent Living Life Profile.

/users/{userId}/medications/{medicationI.description: Private per-user flexible medications and supplements list (multi-dose & weekday schedules).

/users/{userId}/creativeActivities/{acti.description: Private per-user creative activities, hobbies, and side projects with weekly session goals.

/users/{userId}/memories/{memoryId}.description: Private per-user permanent Gemini memory bank storing all rules, conflict resolution preferences, and lifestyle principles.
